entities.name: UniProt:B9KBR9
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Thermotoga neapolitana biotin synthase (100% identity and coverage).
Catalyzes radical-mediated sulfur insertion into dethiobiotin to form biotin; EC 2.8.1.6.
Reference annotations report one [4Fe-4S] cluster and one [2Fe-2S] cluster; homodimeric.
Sequence length 279 aa; calculated molecular mass 31.0 kDa and pI 5.93.
Pfam matches: Radical_SAM (PF04055; residues 18–175) and BATS (PF06968; residues 186–271).

entities.name: Biotin biosynthesis
observations: Biotin synthase performs the terminal sulfur-insertion step converting dethiobiotin to biotin.
